title: Social Security Legislation Amendment (Community Development Program) Bill 2018
short_title: Social Security Legislation Amendment (Community Development Program) Bill 2018

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would bring remote Community Development Program participants under the Targeted Compliance Framework, replacing their separate compliance rules and creating exemptions for subsidised employment.
Participants in qualifying subsidised jobs would be exempt from additional activity tests and mutual obligations while employed, even if they still receive part-rate income support.
The main amendments would commence by proclamation, with a six-month fallback after Royal Assent, and specified exceptions would protect participants declining or leaving subsidised jobs.
changes: The existing compliance division used for remote participants would be repealed.
Refusing a subsidised job would not count as a work refusal failure.
People in subsidised work could decline other suitable employment without a work refusal failure.
Leaving subsidised work voluntarily or through misconduct dismissal would not itself create an unemployment failure.
summary.affected: Remote program participants receiving specified income support payments, including those entering subsidised jobs, and their service providers are affected.
